caption: The drawing depicts two objects against a plain, light beige background. The upper object appears to be the underside of a shallow, round bowl or dish, shown in a top-down view. It is light brown with concentric circles forming raised rings, and there is some dark writing or marking in the center of the base. The lower object is an oval-shaped shallow bowl or platter, seen from an angled top-down view. It is similarly light brown with darker marbling and shading, and features a decorative border of repeating dark motifs, possibly resembling simple floral or leaf patterns, around the rim. Both objects are rendered in naturalistic, muted tones, and the artist's name "Wellington Blewett" appears in the lower right corner of the drawing.
title: Plate Treen
